text:
Alex: Morning — quick check: can we compress this week's triage to 30m? Proposed agenda in Notion: https://notion.redwood/trigage/agenda. Want to add 10m RFC review + 10m quick bugs lane + 10m owner rollcall. Also suggestion: asynchronous pre-reads — owners add one-line status in thread before meeting. Thoughts?

Morgan: +1 to pre-reads. 30m works if we drop deep dives. Can we alternate RFC reviews every other week? :thinking_face:

Sophie: prefer RFC every week early while runway is short. Maybe make the 'owner rollcall' 5m and use remaining 5m for urgent unblockers.

Devon: I can take RFC slot this week. Also need one owner for bug #4521 — pinging @Alex

Alex: Thanks @Devon. I've added you to the RFC slot. Proposed mini-agenda:
```
- 0-5m quick status
- 5-15m RFC review (Devon)
- 15-25m bug triage (top 3)
- 25-30m owner rollcall + actions
```
We'll trial rotating bug owners: owner of the highest-priority bug picks backups for the week.

Morgan: Quick poll — move meeting from 10:00 -> 9:30? Less overlap with product sync. React with :thumbsup: for 9:30, :thumbsdown: to keep 10:00.

triage-bot: Poll created: weekly-triage-time (9:30 or 10:00). Link: https://redwood-inference/polls/weekly-triage-time-1842109876

Sophie: :thumbsup: 9:30 works for me.

Alex: OK 9:30 is leading. Finalize by EOD. Action items:
- Devon: RFC summary + slides by Tue EOD
- Owners: add one-line pre-read by Tue EOD in this thread
- Morgan: update calendar invite + agenda link
Thanks everyone :rocket:

Devon: noted, will post RFC summary and attach slides in #eng by Tue.
